# 2 Kings 10 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Kings 10 (36 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.1 — "sons" vs. "descendants"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "seventy sons" / **PNEUMA:** "seventy descendants"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "seventy sons" — *banim* here refers to immediate male heirs, not broader descendants.

---

## V.6 — "heads" — ambiguity of *rashey*
- **All translators:** "the heads" (unanimous)
- **SOPHIA ruling:** Render literally; address the ambiguity (heads vs. leaders/chiefs) in notes.

---

## V.9 — "righteous" vs. "innocent"
- **EMET:** "righteous [tsaddiqim]" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "innocent"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "innocent" — in this forensic-rhetorical context, "innocent" better captures Jehu's argument.

---

## V.15 — "Is your heart right" vs. "true" vs. "heart and soul"
- **EMET:** "Is your heart right" / **LOGOS:** "Is your heart true to mine" / **PNEUMA:** "Are you with me heart and soul"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Is your heart true to mine" — captures the relational dimension while maintaining formality.

---

## V.19 — "cunning" vs. "trick"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "cunning" (*be-oqbah*) / **PNEUMA:** "trick/treachery"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "with cunning" — preserves the moral ambiguity of the narrator's comment.

---

## V.32 — "cut off" vs. "reduce"
- **EMET:** "to cut off" / **LOGOS:** "to cut off parts of" / **PNEUMA:** "to reduce the size of"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "to reduce Israel" — clearest rendering of territorial diminishment.

---
*— SOPHIA*
